Red Acre Holding, established in Malta in 2019, anchors the commercial activity linked to Jason Harold Morton. He participates in its governance as a board member and authorised representative, working within a group that supplies software, back-office functions and specialist infrastructure to online trading businesses.

His remit reaches Cor Prime UK, where he shares formal control with Shane and Owen Morton. Taken together, the roles connect platform development with payment support, compliance and virtual-asset services. That combination places Morton at the intersection of software delivery and regulated finance, with an emphasis on the systems and administrative functions behind online markets.
